create_bullet_client_direct: create a BulletClient instance in DIRECT mode for headless physics simulation
set_additional_search_path: set the additional search path for loading URDF and SDF data files
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model file into a PyBullet simulation scene
load_sdf_scene: load an SDF scene file into a PyBullet simulation client
get_num_bodies: get the number of rigid bodies currently loaded in a simulation scene
